meta.title: About
meta.description: Nicholaisen — sales, engineering and consulting for the wood, plastics and aluminum industries.

hero.title: Your efficiency partner.
hero.lede: Sales, engineering and consulting for innovative machine solutions in the wood, plastics and aluminum industries — for over 50 years.

what.title: Together with you, we analyze and illuminate your data, strengths and potentials.
what.body1: We provide sales, engineering and consulting of innovative machine solutions and service concepts. We advise on intelligent optimizations and profitable investments — from the first conversation through long after commissioning.
what.body2: Most of our customers stay with us for decades. That isn't loyalty for its own sake — it's the practical result of working with a partner who knows the line and shows up when something is off.

principles.dataDesc: Every recommendation we make is anchored in what the line is actually doing — not what it should be doing on paper.
principles.specificDesc: We'd rather promise a 6-minute changeover than a digital transformation. Specific is testable.
principles.longDesc: We work with our customers across investment cycles, not just projects. The good results compound.

history.title: Five decades, four turning points.
history.1972Desc: Started as a sales agent for woodworking machinery. The hard-won shop-floor knowledge from that era still shapes how we work.
history.1990sDesc: Customers asked for more than equipment — they wanted layouts, integrations, results. Engineering became part of the offer.
history.2010sDesc: Pre-investment data analysis. Production optimization. Capacity planning. The advisory work formalized into named tracks.
history.todayDesc: Real-time machine data turned into the decisions that move the line. Where strategy and shop floor meet.
